description: This file defines the ViewJson class, extending SugarView, responsible for rendering a JSON representation of a bean's fields within the SuiteCRM framework. It processes the bean's column and additional fields, sanitizes and formats their content, and outputs JSON.

classes.name: ViewJson
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to output bean data as JSON.

methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.
